title: Sens. Kirsten Gillibrand and Dave McCormick introduce a bill banning members of the legislative and executive branches from trading on prediction markets (Jason Beeferman/Politico)
summary: Jason Beeferman / Politico: Sens. Kirsten Gillibrand and Dave McCormick introduce a bill banning members of the legislative and executive branches from trading on prediction markets — The bill comes two days after a U.S. soldier was arraigned in federal court on charges he used insider knowledge of the military's plans …
